verdict.rationale: LibreChat is primarily a chat UI where natural language is the default input mode for conversations, agent creation via mention (@) triggers, and tool invocation through agents/MCP happens conversationally rather than via explicit commands. However, core operations like installation, configuration (librechat.yaml, .env), and admin settings still require YAML/CLI/GUI panels rather than natural-language commands. missing for 10: evidence of natural-language driven configuration/administration, a documented command palette or NL-to-action system beyond chat/agent invocation, and independent hands-on confirmation that non-conversational operations can be done via natural language.
